title: Durvalumab in Combination With Chemotherapy and Bevacizumab, Followed by Maintenance Durvalumab, Bevacizumab and Olaparib in Advanced Ovarian Cancer (DUO-O)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Newly diagnosed advanced epithelial ovarian cancer (FIGO stage III or IV). Prior first-line platinum-based chemotherapy. Known BRCA mutation and HRD status. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Prior PARP inhibitor or anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy, severe organ dysfunction.

title: Phase Ib/II Trial of Osimertinib Combination Therapies in Patients with EGFRm-positive and MET-amplified NSCLC (ORCHARD)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC harboring EGFR activating mutation (L858R or Exon 19 del) with acquired MET amplification following disease progression on first-line osimertinib. Age >= 18. Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1. Exclusion: Active interstitial lung disease, severe hepatic impairment, prior MET inhibitor therapy.

locations.facility: The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust

title: Phase Ib/II Study of Amivantamab and Lazertinib in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC Post-Osimertinib (CHRYSALIS-2)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed metastatic NSCLC with sensitizing EGFR mutation (exon 19 del or L858R). For published Cohort A: progression on both osimertinib and platinum-based chemotherapy. Other exploratory cohorts evaluate post-osimertinib platinum-naive combinations. Bispecific targeting of EGFR and MET bypass resistance. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Untreated brain metastases, severe interstitial lung disease.

title: Testing the Addition of Abemaciclib to Olaparib for Women With Recurrent Ovarian Cancer
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Recurrent platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian carcinoma. Documented BRCA1/2 alteration or HRD loss of heterozygosity. Female age >= 18. ECOG <= 2. Hemoglobin >= 10 g/dL, ANC >= 1500, platelets >= 100k. Exclusion: Prior CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy, severe gastrointestinal absorption disorders, active thromboembolism.

locations.facility: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania

title: Carboplatin or Olaparib for BRCA-deficient Prostate Cancer (COBRA)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Documented deleterious mutation in BRCA1 or BRCA2. Castration-resistant metastatic prostate cancer. Age >= 18. Adequate renal function CrCL > 51 mL/min. Exclusion: Small cell histology, prior PARP inhibitor resistance, known active brain metastasis.
sponsor: VA Office of Research and Development

locations.facility: VA Puget Sound Health Care System

title: Testing Olaparib for One or Two Years With or Without Bevacizumab in Ovarian Cancer
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: FIGO Stage III or IV ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal adenocarcinoma. Documented pathogenic variant in BRCA1 or BRCA2, or HRD positive. Completed frontline platinum chemotherapy. ECOG <= 2. Age >= 18. Exclusion: Prior PARP inhibitor maintenance, active gastrointestinal perforation risk.

title: Phase 1/2 Study of MRTX849 (Adagrasib) in Patients with Advanced Solid Tumors with KRAS G12C Mutation (KRYSTAL-1)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Unresectable or metastatic solid tumor harboring KRAS G12C mutation confirmed by CLIA-certified NGS. Progression after prior systemic therapy. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Active brain metastases requiring steroids, prior KRAS G12C targeted small molecule.

title: Phase III Study of Alpelisib Plus Fulvestrant in Patients with PIK3CA-Mutated HR+/HER2- Advanced Breast Cancer (SOLAR-1)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Postmenopausal women or men with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer with confirmed PIK3CA alteration. Progression on or after aromatase inhibitor. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Fasting plasma glucose <= 140 mg/dL, HbA1c <= 6.4%. Exclusion: Type 1 diabetes or uncontrolled Type 2 diabetes, prior PI3K inhibitor.

title: A Phase III Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) vs. Chemotherapy in Microsatellite Instability-High (MSI-H) or Mismatch Repair Deficient (dMMR) Stage IV Colorectal Carcinoma (KEYNOTE-177)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed metastatic colorectal carcinoma with confirmed MSI-H or dMMR status. Treatment-naive in metastatic setting. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressants, prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody.

title: A Phase III, Double-blind, Randomised Study to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of AZD9291 Versus a Standard of Care Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor as First Line Treatment in Patients With Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Mutation Positive, Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non Small Cell Lung Cancer (FLAURA)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Treatment-naive locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with confirmed sensitizing EGFR mutation (Exon 19 del or L858R). Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Prior EGFR TKI or prior systemic therapy for advanced NSCLC, interstitial lung disease.

title: A Phase III, Randomised, Double Blind, Placebo Controlled, Multicentre Study of Olaparib Maintenance Monotherapy in Patients With BRCA Mutated Advanced (FIGO Stage III-IV) Ovarian Cancer Following First Line Platinum Based Chemotherapy (SOLO-1)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Newly diagnosed advanced FIGO stage III-IV high-grade serous or endometrioid ovarian cancer with deleterious germline or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation. Partial or complete response to frontline platinum-based chemotherapy. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1.

title: A Modular Phase I/IIa, Open-label, Multicentre Study to Assess the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Preliminary Efficacy of Ascending Doses of AZD5305 as Monotherapy and in Combination With Anti-cancer Agents in Patients With Advanced Solid Malignancies (PETRA)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Advanced solid tumors with documented deleterious mutation in BRCA1/2, PALB2, or RAD51C/D. Disease progression following prior standard systemic therapy. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Active uncontrolled CNS disease.

title: Randomized, Double-Blind, Phase III Trial Olaparib vs. Placebo Patients With Advanced FIGO Stage IIIB-IV High Grade Serious or Endometrioid Ovarian, Fallopian Tube, or Peritoneal Cancer Treated Standard First-Line Treatment (PAOLA-1)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Newly diagnosed advanced FIGO stage IIIB-IV ovarian cancer in response following frontline platinum-taxane chemotherapy plus bevacizumab. Known BRCA/HRD status.

title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study of Niraparib Maintenance Treatment in Patients With Advanced Ovarian Cancer Following Response on Front-Line Platinum-Based Chemotherapy (PRIMA)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Newly diagnosed advanced high-grade serous or endometrioid ovarian cancer with complete or partial response following frontline platinum-based chemotherapy. HRD and BRCA testing performed.

title: A Phase 3, Open-Label, Randomized Study of Amivantamab and Lazertinib in Combination With Platinum-Based Chemotherapy Compared With Platinum-Based Chemotherapy in Patients With EGFR-Mutated Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer After Osimertinib Failure (MARIPOSA-2)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR Exon 19 del or L858R mutation that progressed on or after osimertinib monotherapy. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1.
